# MossFormer2 source

The archive contains only the MossFormer2 separation modules and Apache-2.0
license from [ClearerVoice-Studio](https://github.com/modelscope/ClearerVoice-Studio)
at commit 6b3774dc79c46ae8bed2a4fa5f706f0ac8c75c61. Original notices and
attribution in the source files are retained. See manifest.json for the archive
identity and model revisions.

The weights are downloaded separately from pinned Hugging Face revisions, with
exact size and SHA-256 verification. This archive contains no weights.
